narr: Heavy rainfall and numerous slow-moving thunderstorms traversed portions of Northern Alabama on April 24th. A Flood Watch was in effect, and several locations in and around Moulton, AL experienced flash flooding from the heavy rainfall episode.
ev: Report of running water over the roadway on Beacon Street in Moulton, AL. Depth of water estimated at 6 to 8 inches.
Report of flooding on the roadway on Old Hillsboro Road in Moulton, AL. Depth of water estimated at 6 inches and rising.
Public report of water flowing over CR 225 near CR 231 in Lawrence County, northeast of Moulton. Depth of water estimated at 5 to 7 inches and rising.
Report of water flowing over the roadway on CR 170 just east of AL 157 in Moulton, AL. Depth of water estimated at 6 to 8 inches.
